description: A file named *.test.tsx or *.spec.tsx is a test file wherever it sits: it is left out of the grade and its imports count as uses for the dead-export finder, the same as a .test.ts file. Nothing else changes.

specs.description: An export used only by a .test.tsx file beside its component is not dead
specs.given: A TypeScript project with src/ui/Button.tsx exporting `Button` and `buttonVariants`. src/ui/App.tsx imports `Button`. src/ui/Button.test.tsx, which is not under any test folder, imports `buttonVariants` from ./Button. No other file names `buttonVariants`.
specs.when: ArchAnalysisPort::analyze runs on the project root
specs.then: dead_exports has no entry with file src/ui/Button.tsx and export_name `buttonVariants`

specs.description: A .spec.tsx file is left out of the grade
specs.given: A TypeScript project whose source files are all classified into layers, plus src/ui/Card.spec.tsx outside any test folder
specs.then: coverage.unclassified does not contain src/ui/Card.spec.tsx; coverage.total equals the count of the project's files other than src/ui/Card.spec.tsx; no violations entry has src/ui/Card.spec.tsx as edge.from_file or edge.to_file

specs.description: A .test.tsx file's own exports are never reported dead
specs.given: src/ui/Button.test.tsx exports a helper `renderButton` that no other file names
specs.then: dead_exports has no entry whose file is src/ui/Button.test.tsx

specs.description: The rule holds at any depth and at the project root
specs.given: Three files: Root.test.tsx at the project root, src/features/billing/deep/Invoice.spec.tsx, and src/ui/__tests__/Modal.test.tsx. Each imports a distinct export from its own component, and that export has no other user.
specs.then: none of the three files appears in coverage.unclassified or counts in coverage.total, and none of the three imported exports appears in dead_exports

specs.description: Excluding the .test.tsx file lowers the file count
specs.given: Project A has N graded source files. Project B is project A plus src/ui/Button.test.tsx outside any test folder.
specs.then: project B's file_count and coverage.total equal project A's

specs.description: A name that only contains 'test' before .tsx is not a test file
specs.given: src/ui/Contest.tsx, src/ui/latest.tsx and src/ui/Button.tests.tsx, each exporting a symbol no other file names, outside any test folder
specs.then: each of the three files is counted in coverage.total, and each one's unused export appears in dead_exports

specs.description: A .test.tsx file only adds uses; it does not mark an export that nothing imports as used
specs.given: src/ui/Button.tsx exports `Button` and `legacyButton`. src/ui/Button.test.tsx imports only `Button`. No file names `legacyButton`.
specs.then: dead_exports contains an entry with file src/ui/Button.tsx and export_name `legacyButton`

specs.description: The suffix must be at the end of the name
specs.given: src/ui/Button.test.tsx.snap and src/ui/Button.spec.tsx.orig exist next to src/ui/Button.tsx, which exports `unusedThing`. Neither of those two files is a recognised source file.
specs.then: neither file is treated as a test whose imports count as uses, and `unusedThing` in src/ui/Button.tsx appears in dead_exports

specs.description: A .tsx test is read exactly as a .ts test with the same content
specs.given: Any TypeScript project P that contains a file F named X.test.ts or X.spec.ts at any path, and P', which is P with F renamed to X.test.tsx or X.spec.tsx respectively and its content unchanged
specs.when: analyze runs on P and on P'
specs.then: dead_exports, coverage.total, coverage.classified, coverage.unclassified, file_count and health_score are equal for P and P'

specs.description: For every path ending in .test.tsx or .spec.tsx, the file is excluded and its imports are uses
specs.given: Any project and any file at any path whose name ends in `.test.tsx` or `.spec.tsx`
specs.then: the file is not in coverage.unclassified and does not count in coverage.total; no dead_exports entry has it as file; no export the file imports by name appears in dead_exports

specs.description: A .test.ts file still works as before
specs.given: src/ui/format.ts exports `formatDate`, used only by src/ui/format.test.ts, which sits outside any test folder
specs.then: `formatDate` is not in dead_exports, and src/ui/format.test.ts is not in coverage.total or coverage.unclassified

specs.description: Test folders and other languages' test files work as before
specs.given: A project with tests/integration.ts, src/__tests__/util.ts, pkg/store_test.go and src/lib.test.rs, each importing one export that has no other user
specs.then: none of the four files counts in coverage.total, and none of the four imported exports appears in dead_exports

specs.description: An ordinary .tsx component is still graded as source
specs.given: src/ui/Button.tsx outside any test folder, exporting `Button`, which no file names
specs.then: src/ui/Button.tsx counts in coverage.total, and dead_exports contains file src/ui/Button.tsx with export_name `Button`

specs.description: The change does not extend to other JS/TS test suffixes the ADR does not name
specs.given: src/ui/Widget.test.jsx outside any test folder, exporting `helper`, which no file names
specs.then: src/ui/Widget.test.jsx is graded as it was before this ADR: it counts in coverage.total and its `helper` export appears in dead_exports

specs.description: An export used only by an ordinary .tsx file is not a test use
specs.given: src/ui/Button.tsx exports `Button`. Only src/ui/Story.tsx, a non-test file, imports it.
specs.then: src/ui/Story.tsx counts in coverage.total, and its import of `Button` counts as an ordinary source import, which keeps `Button` live

specs.description: Projects with no .test.tsx or .spec.tsx file are unaffected
specs.given: Any project P that contains no file named *.test.tsx or *.spec.tsx
specs.then: every file is a test file exactly when its name ends in .test.ts, .spec.ts, _test.go or .test.rs, or it sits under /tests/, /test/ or /__tests__/; every other file the grade reads counts in coverage.total; dead_exports, coverage, file_count and health_score are what those pre-existing rules alone produce

specs.description: Adding a .test.tsx file changes nothing about the other files
specs.given: Any project P and P', which is P plus one file T named *.test.tsx or *.spec.tsx at any path
specs.when: analyze runs on P and on P'
specs.then: coverage.unclassified is the same for P and P'; coverage.total is the same; dead_exports for P' equals dead_exports for P minus exactly the entries whose exports T imports by name
